messages:
sam: Proposal: add a preview-run API for runtime config changes. Mirror a tiny sample of live requests through the new routing/quotas logic in read-only mode to catch regressions.

jen: Good. Must ensure previews don't affect billing/SLOs and redact PII. Also need per-org preview budget and per-run cap.

marco: API sketch:
POST /v1/configs/preview-run
{ patch: ..., sample_pct: 0.1, duration_sec: 600, budget_tokens: 5000 } -> preview_id

rachel: Console UX: show preview_id, live diffs vs baseline, abort & promote buttons, estimated cost. Promote should start canary with --auto-rollback.

infra-bot: AUDIT: preview_start preview_id=prv_6267894321 initiator=sam

jen: Implementation: router flag mirror=preview_id to fork requests to preview shard pool; preview connectors must be read-only and preview logs encrypted with preview-only KMS. Warmup phase to prime caches.

marco: Locking: allow concurrent previews but require a lightweight write-fence on final apply: fail if config_head != preview_base.

sam: Next steps: jen+marco proto the API and mirror flow (2w), rachel mockups (1w), security redaction policy (1w). Will file tickets. :thumbsup:
